div.head: I Atr 4
div.ab: ⁊ gif hwylc man sy, þe eallon folce ungetrywe sy, fare þæs cynges gerefa to ⁊ gebringe hine under borge, þæt hine man tó rihte gelæde þam þe him onspræcon.
⁊ gyf hwylc man sy, ðe eallon folce ungetrywe sy, fare ðæs cynges gerefa to ⁊ gebringe hine under borge, þæt hine man to rihte geléde ðam ðe him onspæcon.
Et si aliquis hominum sit, qui omni populo sit incredibilis, adeat prepositus regis et mittat cum sub plegio, ut ad rectum perducatur eis qui compellabunt eum.
[Be ðæm men ðe eallum folc ungetrywe sy.] [Ld] ⁊ gyf hwylc man sy ðe eallon folce ungetrywe sy, fare ðæs cynges gerefa to ⁊ gebringe hine under borge þæt hine man to rihte gelǽde ðam ðe him onspæcon.

And if there is anyone who is regarded with suspicion by the general public, the king's reeve shall go and place him under surety so that he may be brought to do justice to those who have made charges against him.

(Von dem Manne, der allem Volke verdächtig ist. Ld) Und wenn jemand ist, der allem Volke Vertrauens unwürdig gilt, so schreite der Königsvogt ein und bringe ihn unter Bürgschaft, dass diese ihn denen, die ihn anklagen mögen, zur Rechtserfüllung stelle.

(Of the man who is suspected by all the people. Ld) And if there is anyone who is considered untrustworthy by all the people, let the king's reeve intervene and bring him under surety, so that it may produce him for justice to those who may accuse him.
